snippet.title: How Selling Cereal Saved Airbnb!
snippet.description:
Discover the surprising story of how Airbnb founders Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia saved their startup by selling limited-edition cereal boxes during the 2008 presidential election. With no money for rent and their home-sharing platform struggling to gain traction, they came up with the creative idea of "Obama O’s" and "Cap’n McCain’s" cereal. The quirky stunt raised $30,000 and helped keep Airbnb alive long enough to secure funding. Learn how this unusual marketing move laid the foundation for what would become a $100 billion company.
